Name: Tree Organizer
Author: ProfeJavix
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img]﻿
If you are one of those players obsessed with organization and order, then you know how annoying it is when you have a tree in a certain position and now you want to place it somewhere else, which means cutting it down and waiting for it to grow again (which can mean losing an entire season of fruits and other materials).
With this you can pick it up only by pressing a button (default Left Shift + O, configurable) and place it in an allowed position of your farm.
This will work with Fruit Trees and any machine in the tree's tile.


[size=4][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img]﻿
[/b][/size]Download, extract the file and copy the extracted folder into the Mods folder on your game's location.

This mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.14 and SMAPI 4.1.10+

If you are interested, here is the [url=https://github.com/ProfeJavix/StardewValleyMods/tree/main/TreeOrganizer]Source Code[/url] ;)﻿
﻿[/center]
